blurb: The Timberlake Tavern is an event center in Lynchburg Virginia with indoor and outdoor spaces for celebrations and meetings up to 125 people. Weddings, receptions, meetings, baby showers, bridal showers, anniversaries, memorial celebrations and birthday parties special at The Timberlake Tavern.
